requirement: Approved building plan and completion or occupancy certificate
applies_to: Technical institutions, subject to applicable provisions
verification_method: Check records, issuing authority, property details, and consistency
notes: The handbook includes a specific condition for partial or provisional occupancy certificates.

applies_to: Technical institutions, subject to applicable provisions
verification_method: Check certificate presence, issuing authority, validity, and premises identity
notes: The handbook states that the certificate is to be obtained before submitting the AICTE application.

requirement: Structural stability and safe-foundation certificates for specified additional construction
applies_to: Institutions undertaking additional construction under the stated condition
verification_method: Check applicability, certificate presence, engineer qualifications, building identity, and date
notes: Do not apply this condition to every institution without checking the circumstances described in the handbook.

requirement: Land area may be distributed across no more than three plots under the stated conditions
applies_to: Institutions subject to the general plot requirements and stated exceptions
verification_method: Check plot records, plot count, distances, permitted use, and applicable exceptions
notes: The handbook specifies additional conditions for the main plot, other plots, and hilly regions.

requirement: Access and circulation area and total built-up-area calculation
applies_to: Institutions subject to the stated area calculation
verification_method: Check the calculation against instructional, administrative, and amenities areas
notes: The handbook describes ACA as around 25% and provides the total built-up-area formula.

requirement: Classroom area for a division of 60 students
applies_to: Engineering and Technology institutions covered by this table
verification_method: Compare documented classroom carpet area with the applicable programme and intake requirements
notes: The table specifies 33 square metres for a division of 30; required room count depends on the handbook formula.

requirement: First-year laboratories, including two basic-science laboratories, up to the stated intake
applies_to: Engineering and Technology institutions covered by this table
verification_method: Check laboratory inventory, documented rooms, approved intake, and applicable course requirements
notes: The table specifies 66 square metres per room. Other laboratory requirements depend on course and year.

requirement: At least one smart classroom per course with specified equipment
applies_to: Institutions covered by the stated note
verification_method: Check room inventory and documented availability of projector, smart board, and internet connection
notes: Verify applicability against the complete handbook and institution category.

requirement: Minimum administrative carpet area for approved intake up to 300
verification_method: Compare the reported administrative carpet area with the applicable intake and programme rules
notes: The handbook says the administrative area should be doubled for the all-inclusive office when an institution has more than one programme; check the exact provision.

requirement: Minimum amenities carpet area for approved intake up to 300
verification_method: Compare reported amenities area with the applicable intake and programme rules
notes: The handbook describes amenities including toilets, common rooms, cafeteria, and first-aid/sick room.
